title: rosa bengalensis
intro: Rosa bengalensis, commonly known as the Bengal rose, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa bengalensis are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and provide relief from pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
